findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy Header
findings.description: The response does not include the 'content-security-policy' security header.
findings.recommendation: Implement a Content-Security-Policy to prevent XSS and data injection attacks.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options Header
findings.description: The response does not include the 'x-content-type-options' security header.
findings.recommendation: Add 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' to prevent MIME-type sniffing attacks.

findings.title: Cookie Without HttpOnly Flag: __Secure-STRP
findings.description: Cookie is missing the HttpOnly flag; it is accessible via JavaScript (XSS risk).
findings.evidence: __Secure-STRP=AD6DogtjzHKiwjmehLrYEB_3mYpKwTnlRt1DoLTtSiCk39w2T7yhUPGjJhUQFQSU8_4hbUe_zZixA6x18pQo0GPYDg_q8tuchhoO; expires=Wed, 04-Mar-2026 05:41:50 GMT; path=/; domain=.google.com; Secure; SameSite=
findings.recommendation: Add the HttpOnly attribute to prevent JavaScript access to cookies.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy Header
findings.description: The response does not include the 'referrer-policy' security header.
findings.recommendation: Add 'Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin' to control referrer info.

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy Header
findings.description: The response does not include the 'permissions-policy' security header.
findings.recommendation: Add a Permissions-Policy header to control browser feature access.

findings.title: X-XSS-Protection Disabled
findings.recommendation: Remove this header or set to '1; mode=block'. Rely on CSP instead.

findings.title: Technology Disclosure via Server Header
findings.description: Server discloses technology information in the 'server' header.
findings.recommendation: Remove or sanitize the 'server' header to prevent technology fingerprinting.

findings.title: HSTS Missing includeSubDomains
findings.description: HSTS does not include the 'includeSubDomains' directive.
